prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

+"""Maintain the order of active episodes within a project."""
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.models import Episode, Project
+
+
+def ordered_episodes(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> list[Episode]:
+    # Serialize order changes for this project on databases supporting row locks.
+    session.exec(select(Project).where(Project.id == project_id).with_for_update()).first()
+    episodes = list(session.exec(
+        select(Episode).where(Episode.project_id == project_id, Episode.deleted_at == None)
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id)
+        .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
+    ).all())
+    for order, episode in enumerate(episodes, 1):
+        if episode.episode_order != order:
+            episode.episode_order = order
+            session.add(episode)
+    return episodes

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4

+def test_duplicate_episode_copies_cuts_and_is_independent(client):

+        session.flush()
+        original = Episode(project_id=project.id, title='First', story_summary='Story', episode_order=2,
+                           character_outfits={'Hero': 'coat'})
+        session.add(original)
+        session.flush()
+        session.add(Episode(project_id=project.id, title='Later', episode_order=7))
+        for order in (2, 1):
+            session.add(StoryCut(episode_id=original.id, cut_order=order, script=f'Script {order}',
+                                 selected_layout='wide', aspect_ratio='16:9', image_path='data:image/png;base64,YQ==',
+                                 dialogues=[{'speaker': 'Hero', 'text': 'Hello'}],
+                                 appearing_characters=[{'id': 'hero', 'name': 'Hero'}]))
+        session.commit()
+        original_id = original.id
+        project_id = project.id
+        before = len(session.exec(select(CreditTransaction)).all())
+
+    url = f'/api/v1/episodes/{original_id}/duplicate'
+    assert client.post(url, headers=outsider).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/duplicate', headers=headers).status_code == 404
+    response = client.post(url, headers=headers)
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    copy = response.json()
+    assert copy['id'] != str(original_id)
+    assert copy['title'] == 'First (Copy)'
+    assert copy['episode_order'] == 2
+    listing = client.get(f'/api/v1/episodes/?project_id={project_id}', headers=headers).json()
+    assert [(ep['title'], ep['episode_order']) for ep in listing] == [
+        ('First', 1), ('First (Copy)', 2), ('Later', 3)]
+    assert copy['story_summary'] == 'Story'
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        source = session.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == original_id).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)).all()
+        cloned = session.exec(select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == UUID(copy['id'])).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)).all()
+        assert len(cloned) == 2
+        for a, b in zip(source, cloned):
+            assert a.id != b.id
+            for field in ('cut_order', 'script', 'selected_layout', 'aspect_ratio', 'image_path', 'dialogues', 'appearing_characters'):
+                assert getattr(a, field) == getattr(b, field)
+        assert len(session.exec(select(CreditTransaction)).all()) == before
+        cloned[0].script = 'Changed'
+        session.add(cloned[0])
+        session.commit()

+    assert client.delete(f'/api/v1/episodes/{original_id}', headers=headers).status_code == 204

+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models import Episode, Project, StoryCut, WorkspaceMember
+from app.models.models import User
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def test_restore_episode_preserves_cuts_and_inserts_at_deleted_position(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    outsider = signup(client, '<email>')
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        user = session.exec(select(User).where(User.email == '<email>')).one()
+        member = session.exec(select(WorkspaceMember).where(WorkspaceMember.user_id == user.id)).one()
+        project = Project(title='Series', workspace_id=member.workspace_id, owner_id=user.id, style_preset='comic')
+        session.add(project)
+        session.flush()
+        episodes = [Episode(project_id=project.id, title=title, episode_order=i)
+                    for i, title in enumerate(('One', 'Two', 'Three'), 1)]
+        session.add_all(episodes)
+        session.flush()
+        cut = StoryCut(episode_id=episodes[1].id, cut_order=1, script='Original', selected_layout='single', aspect_ratio='1:1')
+        session.add(cut)
+        session.commit()
+        project_id, episode_id, cut_id = project.id, episodes[1].id, cut.id
+
+    restore_url = f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/restore'
+    assert client.post(restore_url, headers=headers).status_code == 404
+    assert client.delete(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}', headers=headers).status_code == 204
+    assert client.post(restore_url, headers=outsider).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f'/api/v1/episodes/{uuid4()}/restore', headers=headers).status_code == 404
+    result = client.post(restore_url, headers=headers)
+    assert result.status_code == 200
+    assert result.json()['episode_order'] == 2
+    listing = client.get(f'/api/v1/episodes/?project_id={project_id}', headers=headers).json()
+    assert [(ep['title'], ep['episode_order']) for ep in listing] == [('One', 1), ('Two', 2), ('Three', 3)]
+    cuts = client.get(f'/api/v1/cuts/?episode_id={episode_id}', headers=headers).json()
+    assert len(cuts) == 1 and cuts[0]['id'] == str(cut_id) and cuts[0]['script'] == 'Original'
+    assert client.post(restore_url, headers=headers).status_code == 404
+
+    # If other episodes are deleted while this one is gone, restore at the end.
+    assert client.delete(f'/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}', headers=headers).status_code == 204
+    for ep in (listing[0], listing[2]):
+        assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=headers).status_code == 204
+    assert client.post(restore_url, headers=headers).json()['episode_order'] == 1
